description: Public and bank holidays for 200+ countries and their regions (states, cantons) for any year, with local names. Optionally check whether a given date is a holiday. Params: country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, required, e.g. DE, US, CH, JP), region (e.g. BY, CA, ZH), year (default current), date (YYYY-MM-DD to check), language (e.g. en), include_observances (default false). Price: $0.002 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"country":"DE","region":"BY","year":2026,"date":"2026-10-03"}.

language.description: Language for holiday names, e.g. en

region.description: State/region code, e.g. BY, CA, ZH

name: holidays
title: Public Holidays
